title: Open Appointments per Purchase Order: Delivery & Pickup Appointments
content:
**Rule.** Under Delivery & Pickup Appointments, a purchase order may have only one open appointment. An appointment is open while its status is scheduled, dispatched or missed. A new appointment is booked only when the order has no open appointment. Across all of the customer's orders, the customer may hold no more than the fulfillment method's maximum orders per window on the same date and window. A customer buying two vehicles therefore needs two windows, unless the method allows two.

**What decides it.** The count of open appointments is read from the system's appointment records for that purchase order. A customer's statement does not decide it. The count is taken for the same purchase order the new appointment would be booked for.

### Which appointment statuses count as open

| Status of an existing appointment on the order | Counts as open | Effect on a new appointment for the same order |
|---|---|---|
| Scheduled | Yes | Blocks it |
| Dispatched | Yes | Blocks it |
| Missed | Yes | Blocks it |
| Completed | No | Does not block it |
| Refused | No | Does not block it |
| Cancelled | No | Does not block it |

An appointment that has been missed stays open until it is rebooked or cancelled, so an order with a missed appointment cannot receive a second appointment beside it.

### Basis questions (hypothetical situations)

**A buyer has two signed orders and wants both vehicles handed over in the same window on the same date.** The number allowed is the method's maximum orders per window. Where the method's maximum is 2, both orders may take that window. Where the maximum is 1, the second order takes a different date or window.

**An order's earlier appointment was cancelled. Can a new one be booked?** A cancelled appointment is not open, so on this count it does not stand in the way of a new appointment for the order.

**An order has a missed appointment on file. Can a fresh appointment be added for the same order?** No. Missed is an open status, and the order may have only one open appointment.
